answer: An oasis clinic in a karst valley sells health statistics to research agents through an ivory-colored kiosk. Keep one differential privacy budget for each protected patient across all buyers and overlapping datasets. Charge every released query to that shared ledger using a valid composition accountant; reject queries that exhaust it. Creating new buyer identities cannot reset the allowance or buy unlimited independent noisy estimates to average away privacy. This needs all release paths to share the accountant, including cached and updated datasets.
